article.story: OXFORD, Ohio -- — Stevie Elam helped lead Miami of Ohio over Defiance on Wednesday with 16 points off of the bench in a 91-69 win. Elam also contributed eight rebounds for the RedHawks (4-0). Evan Ipsaro scored 12 points while going 4 of 6 (3 for 3 from 3-point range). Tyler Robbins had 12 points and went 5 of 7 from the field. Nate Miles led the way for the Yellow Jackets with 25 points. Evan Angstmann added nine points and two steals for Defiance. Jayden Jones finished with seven points. Miami took the lead with 8:37 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Elam led the team in scoring with 11 points in the first half to help put them up 54-35 at the break. Miami pulled away with a 7-0 run in the second half to extend a 19-point lead to 26 points. They outscored Defiance by three points in the final half, as Robbins led the way with a team-high six second-half points. Up next Miami plays Sunday against UIC. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
